verdict.rationale: The first-party README states directly that Solid compiles its templates to real DOM nodes instead of using a Virtual DOM and updates them with fine-grained reactions [solid-gh-20], and that only dependent code reruns [solid-gh-1, solid-gh-10]. The babel-preset-solid compiler setup [solid-gh-23] and render-once components [solid-gh-9] support this. Community reports of strong DOM performance and fine-grained updates corroborate it [solid-comm-1, solid-comm-2, solid-comm-19]. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the compiler's output and optimization strategy, and independent benchmarks specifically attributing the gains to the no-VDOM design.
